purpose: v10 semantic shot-scale and viewpoint QA; authored viewpoints, not more shake or roll
preserve: complete title and Made by Chiyang001 freeze

camera_rules.macro: Use a real near eye-target range and a nearby machine surface; reduce the fixed physical token fixture proportionally. Do not globally widen the lens until the macro becomes another long shot.
camera_rules.high_angle: Show the top of a conveyor, room or computation board; lay the lyric fixture on that plane so its normal faces the authored overhead view.
camera_rules.low_angle: Keep one leg, beam or tooth close enough to crop at an edge; aim above its root. The close foreground makes the angle visible.
camera_rules.side_track: Track along a side-mounted phrase and its host rail. Rotate the fixture into the side wall, not into an eye-facing billboard. Keep reading left-to-right.
camera_rules.fly_through: Use a specific aperture with foreground edges crossing the lens, a midground semantic object and a far destination; do not pass through glyph front faces during their reading dwell.
camera_rules.aerial: Use as scale release after an intimate action, not the default shot. Preserve a visible cause from the preceding shot.
camera_rules.continuity: A new angle may cut decisively, but the red signal, rail or action direction should remain identifiable within 6 frames. Do not ease back to the former frontal camera.

qa_gates: At least 6 clearly visible viewpoint families; shot-family changes must be apparent in a contact sheet, not only through metadata.
No run longer than 2 vocal shots with the same combination of distance, height and frontal direction.
For reading dwell, projected glyph front-normal dot viewing direction remains positive and preferably at least 0.35; check left-to-right words explicitly at reverse/side shots.
Current tokens fully inside screen after the 3-7-frame transition window; count visible tokens <= 2 and no future or completed line appears as a ghost.
Camera must not pass through near-plane geometry which covers most of the screen for more than a deliberate 2-3-frame wipe.
Inspect transition pairs at t-0.15, t+0.15, t+0.7; the new view must stay authored rather than returning to the original frontal framing.
Inspect the shortest tokens at a video frame rate; a large camera jump cannot consume their complete reading dwell.
Keep 4 P(doom) blast events and exact source audio; full ending freeze title and creator remain unchanged.
